original_record.question: The diagram on the right shows a cube of side $18 \mathrm{~cm}$. A giant ant walks across the cube's surface from $\mathrm{X}$ to $\mathrm{Y}$ along the route shown. How far does it walk? <image1>
original_record.solution: From the diagram, the ant walks the equivalent of five edges. Therefore the ant walks $5 \times 18 \mathrm{~cm}=90 \mathrm{~cm}$.
